entries.title: Stage 9 / Event Horizon — white core cannon & continuous synchronized spin
entries.note: Current native Furious fight: original 10965 HP, exact half-health gate, invulnerable input-only observer. No recorder HP/phase/timer writes. Actual level-4 white cannon art, pose-anchored 1015 white core charge and white energy muzzle. Hull, core and spiral share one continuous 0.60-turn/second simulation clock through entry, charge, firing, recovery and water dashes. Bullet-attached asterisks removed globally; actual attack/ground warnings and missile Retina locks remain. Charge, release, beam bed, boost and half-health audio are wired and played. No browser/asset errors.
